subject: Literature
title: Surrealism in Literature
description: Learn Surrealism in Literature in one minute.

hook.text: André Breton wanted to free literature from logic entirely and let the unconscious mind write directly.

buildup.text: Surrealist writers used automatic writing, recording thoughts without editing, to bypass rational control.

discovery.text: The 1924 Surrealist Manifesto declared that dreams and the irrational were more truthful than waking reason.

twist.text: Breton expelled members for political disagreements, running the freedom movement like a strict dictator.

climax.text: Surrealism influenced poetry, film, advertising, and visual art far beyond its original literary ambitions.

punchline.text: The movement for creative freedom had a dictator.

quiz.question: What technique did surrealist writers use?
options: Automatic writing to bypass rational control
